title: NEXUS SMP

body:
Hello!

We’re a Hermitcraft-style Minecraft SMP with the goal of being a friendly, close-knit 18+ community that values creativity, collaboration, and long-term play. Our server has been running in its fourth month on its second season. We have been established for a year now, and continue to grow with dedicated, active members.

Server Details 
- Java Edition (18+)
- Fabric 1.21.11
- Survival-focused gameplay inspired by Hermitcraft

To support creativity and teamwork, we also run a Creative Server where players can: • Test builds and redstone
- Plan large projects
- Collaborate with others before bringing ideas into Survival

We're currently building our player base and seeking long-term members. 

Though season 2 is in the middle of the season, we're looking for established, long-term members who will be with us from season 2 and seasons to come! 

Mic is required during the application, as there will be a quick chat for an interview with our owner or one of the moderators 

📩 Apply by messaging: cede1121 on Discord
—or—
🔗 Join our Discord to apply:
https://discord.gg/EhtgdEuS3Y

We’d love to meet you and see what you bring to the community ✨
